name: hazel_weir_central_procedural_graph
description: High-velocity procedural graph featuring active oracle peak-price arbitrage, contract-synchronized town shop fulfillment, full 30-day crop lifecycle maximization, and order-bandwidth-conserving farm execution.

nodes.name: State & Balance Audit
nodes.description: Computes net available cash, shed fill percentage, wage liability, remaining game ticks, active town shop demand, and oracle price drop signals.

nodes.name: Midnight Wage Reserve Defense
nodes.description: Protects payroll for all active hired hands. Blocks capital expenditure and triggers pre-midnight surplus liquidation to prevent the 0-hand bankruptcy cascade.

nodes.name: Town Shop Demand Arbitrage
nodes.description: Preemptively fulfills unlocked town shop contracts (Carrots, Tomatoes, Strawberries, Eggs) to lock in 2x-3x price premiums before open market disposal.

nodes.name: Shed Headroom Relief
nodes.description: Prevents silent 100/100 harvest discards by clearing low-margin non-feed inventory at fair prices when shed approaches true capacity.

nodes.name: Oracle Market Timing & Paced Liquidation
nodes.description: Leverages 96-step oracle forecasts and spot prices to systematically monetize harvest surpluses at cyclical price peaks and front-run predicted gluts at or above base price in paced tranches.

nodes.name: High-Yield Crop & Market Synchronization
nodes.description: Directs seed budgeting and field planting dynamically toward active Town Shop contracts, high-yield commercial crops (Strawberries, Tomatoes), and terminal fast crops (Carrots, Wheat) through Day 29.

nodes.name: Routine Farm & Workforce Execution
nodes.description: Executes field routines (harvesting, watering, planting, feeding livestock) utilizing at least 8-9 protected order slots each tick.

attributes.guidance: Cancel non-essential purchases (BUY_SEED, BUY_ANIMAL, redundant HIRE); enforce emergency sales of non-feed inventory at hour >= 20 in sized tranches to meet exact payroll shortfall; schedule worker harvest drop-offs before hour 21.
attributes.pitfalls: Never sell Wheat below livestock feed reserve (n_animals * 2); do not liquidate high-multiplier town shop crops to cover minor payroll deficits if non-feed items or surplus wool/fertilizer suffice.

attributes.guidance: Fulfill town shop contract demands (Carrots, Tomatoes, Strawberries, Eggs) immediately to capture 2x-3x price premiums; prioritize shop fulfillment over all open-market sales; coordinate with crop planting to fulfill active shop contract quantities.
attributes.pitfalls: Never sell wheat needed for livestock feed buffer; do not withhold inventory waiting for future theoretical shops if current shop orders are active and unfulfilled.

attributes.guidance: Evict lowest-margin inventory (fertilizer, surplus wheat above reserve, raw wool) at market price >= 0.60 * base_price in tranches of 10-15 units; cancel stale buy orders to recover order slots; route eligible goods to town shops before generic open-market liquidation.
attributes.pitfalls: Never sell town shop contract crops or feed wheat below reserve (n_animals * 2); avoid dumping items below 0.50 * base_price; do not wait until shed reaches 95+ where simultaneous worker drop-offs trigger silent inventory loss.

attributes.condition: (oracle_glut_risk >= 0.50 and current_price >= 1.00 * base_price) or (current_price >= 1.05 * base_price and shed_used >= 25) or (day >= 28 and shed_used >= 15)
attributes.guidance: Execute sales in paced batches (10-15 units per order) limiting sales to 1 order per tick to preserve workforce action bandwidth; defend a minimum liquidation floor of 1.00x base price during predicted gluts rather than fire-selling at a discount; prioritize selling high-value crops (Strawberries, Tomatoes) during cyclical price peaks above base price while retaining town shop reserves and livestock feed wheat.
attributes.pitfalls: Never dump inventory below 1.00x base price during glut alerts unless shed headroom or wage defense forces emergency liquidation; do not emit multiple sell orders in a single turn that exhaust the 10-order engine cap.

attributes.guidance: Dynamically allocate field planting: (1) dedicate necessary plots to fulfill active Town Shop contract demands (Carrots, Tomatoes, Strawberries) to capture 2x-3x multipliers; (2) default to Strawberries and Tomatoes on days 1-24; (3) transition to Tomatoes and Carrots on days 25-27; (4) plant Carrots until day 29 hour 0; (5) plant fast-maturing Wheat on days 28-29 (up to day 29 hour 18) to ensure full field productivity through turn 718; limit seed purchase transactions to 1 order per turn.
attributes.pitfalls: Do not plant Strawberries after day 25 hour 0 or Tomatoes after day 27 hour 12 as they will not mature before turn 718; do not leave fields unplanted on days 28-29 when fast Carrots and Wheat can yield final cash harvests; cease all planting by day 29 hour 18.

attributes.guidance: Dispatch idle hands across at least 8-9 protected action slots: prioritize harvesting mature crops to free plots and collect inventory, immediately water unwatered planted plots to prevent growth stalls, feed livestock, clear weeds, and plant queued seeds; mandate that all workers deposit carried inventory into the shed before turn 718.
attributes.pitfalls: Do not allow market or seed orders to cannibalize worker order slots; never leave mature crops unharvested or newly planted crops unwatered; ensure workers drop off all inventory before terminal turns 718-720.
